title: Origin story: Rama
description: Rama was the prince of Ayodhya, seventh avatar of Vishnu, exiled fourteen years to the forest by his stepmother's boon. When Ravana abducted his wife Sita, Rama allied with the vanaras, built a bridge to Lanka, and slew the demon king in single combat — then ruled as the model of righteous kingship.
